query: Upgrade this project to Cypress v13.
expected_behavior: Identifies the target major as v13 and follows the v13 path (versions/v13).
Confirms cypress is on 12.x and treats it as the valid prerequisite for v13.
Flags Node 14 (from .nvmrc) as an install blocker and recommends at least Node 18.
Flags TypeScript 3.9 as below the minimum supported TypeScript 4.x.
Flags the removed config options videoUploadOnPasses and nodeVersion in cypress.config.ts and recommends removing them.
Notes video: false and videoCompression are now defaults, and that video: false is redundant.
Identifies that the Module API / after:run / after:spec result properties changed and advises reviewing their usage.
Leaves the cy.readFile().its().should() chain in read-file.cy.ts unchanged (no false-positive edit).
Reports Test Replay default-on with --record (allowlist capture.cypress.io) and that the Runner UI is hidden during Test Replay runs.
Halts before installing because of the Node install blocker rather than silently proceeding.
